summary: Columns of cards moved by dragging, within a column or across, with a pointer, a finger or the keyboard.

props.name: defaultColumns
props.description: The columns, left to right, each with its cards.

props.name: onColumnsChange
props.description: Called with the board after a card is dropped.

props.name: counts
props.description: Shows how many cards each column holds.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the columns and cards. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
